notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Reduced animal sound frequency
 Fixed lag when exiting building mode
 Fixed UI issues
 Reduced waiting time for labels to appear
 Removed a non-interactable static truck to avoid confusing players

notes.title: 🗓️Harvest Hills RELEASE DATE🗓️
Major demo update is out!
notes.content:
In this update for the demo, I have made some exciting changes to enhance your gaming experience:

Relaxing Gameplay: Say goodbye to time limits! Enjoy a new free-run mode where you can look after of your farm at your own pace, without any pressure.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43377232/b549ed2570305188e3d847a2fb5fffab6c38737f.png

Market Truck Feature: Introducing the market truck! Earn money by selling your farm products at the local market. Keep an eye out for the truck's visits, where you can sell your goods at competitive prices. Use the earnings to invest in new farm objects and boost your productivity.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43377232/ecb7a10e8e27c40b958806a9f2b70bc105708265.png

New Level System: Unlocking new farm objects is now tied to challenges. Meet specific product selling targets to progress and gain access to new farm objects and upgrades for your rancho.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43377232/f8726ab1239497a31fd75e862300a8f32fd21431.png

Sounds interesting? Download the demo now and start managing your own farm!
